description: uvicorn stale __pycache__ causing import errors on restart
error_log: ImportError: cannot import name 'app' from 'main' (most likely due to a circular import)
expected_fix: Kill uvicorn process and clear __pycache__ before restart
expected_patch:
--- a/scripts/restart.sh
+++ b/scripts/restart.sh
@@ -1,2 +1,4 @@
 #!/bin/sh
+pkill -f uvicorn || true
+find . -type d -name __pycache__ -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
 uvicorn main:app --reload
